notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Angel of Glory's Rise.
You control at least three nontoken Humans.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all nontoken Humans, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Angel of Glory's Rise.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies and returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Each Human enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability that many times.
Resolve all Deadeye Navigator triggers, choosing not to pair any of the Humans with Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat.
